title: Tensor saturation for even spin groups

result.label: Tensor saturation for even spin groups
result.statement: Proves saturation factor one for Spin (2n), n ≥ 2: for three dominant integral weights whose sum lies in the root lattice, an invariant at any common positive integral dilation already gives an invariant at the original weights. This resolves the type- D part of the simply-laced saturation conjecture.
